IdeaSoft partners with ADI Foundation to build blockchain infrastructure tailored for governments, institutions and RWAs

By Globe Newswire
Published on September 1, 2026, 5:55 AM IST 3 min read
Add us as a preferred source on Google
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:47
Instaread

TALLINN, Estonia, Aug. 31, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — ADI Foundation has announced a strategic partnership with IdeaSoft, an international IT company specializing in Web3 and blockchain development. As part of the collaboration, IdeaSoft serves as a technology provider for the ADI ecosystem, contributing to the development and implementation of blockchain solutions for government, institutions and real world asset projects.

ADI Foundation is a blockchain foundation that serves as the governance layer of the ADI ecosystem. It provides technology standards, trust architecture, and regulatory engagement to support the development of digital infrastructure and the implementation of blockchain solutions across government and corporate sectors.

ADI Chain, the ecosystem’s institutional Layer-2 blockchain, launched its mainnet on December 9, 2025, and is designed to support regulated digital finance, tokenized assets, sovereign digital infrastructure, and enterprise-grade blockchain applications.

In February 2026, ADI Announced the launch of DDSC; a Central Bank regulated dirham backed stablecoin operating exclusively on ADI Chain. Developed for institutional and government use cases. DDSC represents a major milestone for regulated digital finance in the region and reinforces ADI Chain’s role as a foundational infrastructure layer for the UAE’s digital economy.

ADI Foundation leverages a global network of partners to deliver blockchain solutions that enhance trust, transparency, and efficiency across key sectors, including healthcare, financial systems, sustainability, and public administration.

As a technology provider for the ADI ecosystem, IdeaSoft continues to contribute to the development and expansion of ADI Chain infrastructure, supporting the delivery of blockchain solutions for various initiatives, including DDSC stablecoin.

In the blockchain industry, IdeaSoft has experience working with both Web3 projects and large institutional clients. Its portfolio includes collaborations with companies and projects across blockchain infrastructure, fintech, digital assets, and enterprise technology, including Solana, Near, Securitize, WorldCoin, NEOM, Stellar, Uniswap, Crédit Agricole, HSBC, and others.

“Abu Dhabi has set an ambitious goal to become a global capital of Web3 and emerging technologies. The region is actively attracting leading talent, innovative companies, and advanced expertise to bring this vision to life. We are pleased to be part of this transformation and to provide technological expertise for government, municipal, and corporate projects within the ADI ecosystem. Our mission is to support the practical implementation of blockchain technologies in finance, public administration, telecommunications, and infrastructure,” says the IdeaSoft team.

For IdeaSoft, this collaboration marks another step in strengthening the presence of Ukrainian technology expertise in the global market. The company’s involvement in developing Web3 infrastructure for the ADI ecosystem demonstrates that Ukrainian engineering teams are capable of working on strategic digital projects of international scale — from Europe to the Middle East.
